name: Camu Einhard
original_name: カミュ・アインハルト
source:
Calling himself "The Earth Warrior of Love," he is a revolutionary who fights for the preservation of the environment.

An engineering student who loves Japanese comics, he has a strong interest in Japanese culture and anime. 

In addition to always being immersed in his own world, his social anxiety prevents him from having friends his age.

He is pure of heart and generally dislikes arguments.

Hometown: Hallstatt [Austria]
